You are the implementation agent on a small web project. Make changes with the provided file tools. Use only the project directory. Follow each user's requirements, preserve earlier behavior, and finish with a short status. Do not paste source code into the chat.

content.text: Build a playable grid puzzle named Beacon Switch with vanilla HTML, CSS and JavaScript in one self-contained index.html. It should work offline by opening that file. Give it a compact title, a short instructions area, a responsive grid and a visible status area. Use a 5x5 board with a deterministic starting puzzle obtained by turning all lights off and then applying one move to the center cell. Clicking a cell flips that cell and its orthogonal neighbors within the board. Count moves, show Won when all lights are off, and stop the board accepting moves after winning. Add a Reset button that restores the starting board and resets moves to 0. A lit cell has aria-pressed="true" and an unlit cell aria-pressed="false". Use buttons with IDs cell-ROW-COL, with zero-based row and column, plus IDs moves, status and reset on the relevant elements. Use only index.html and no CDN or dependencies. Write the file with the tool, then report briefly.

messages.content: Created index.html with Beacon Switch puzzle. Features: 5x5 grid, deterministic start (all off + center flip), click-to-flip with orthogonal neighbors, move counter, win detection, reset button, responsive design, and proper ARIA attributes. File saved successfully.

content.text: Add a one-move Undo button to the existing app, with id undo. Undo reverts the most recent move and restores the previous move count and status, including after a win. After Undo the button must be disabled until another move. Reset should disable Undo. Keep all prior features and IDs. Read the existing index.html before editing it.

content.text: Add keyboard navigation to the grid. With focus on a cell, arrow keys move focus one cell in each direction, without wrapping at the board edges, and do not change puzzle state or the move count. Use the native button's Space and Enter activation. When starting from the top-left cell, ArrowRight then ArrowDown should reach row 1, column 1. Preserve all IDs and earlier behaviors, including Undo.

function.name: read
function.description: Read the contents of a file. Supports text files and images (jpg, png, gif, webp, bmp). Images are sent as attachments. For text files, output is truncated to 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). Use offset/limit for large files. When you need the full file, continue with offset until complete.

path.description: Path to the file to read (relative or absolute)

offset.description: Line number to start reading from (1-indexed)

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to read

function.name: write
function.description: Write content to a file. Creates the file if it doesn't exist, overwrites if it does. Automatically creates parent directories.

path.description: Path to the file to write (relative or absolute)

content.description: Content to write to the file

function.name: edit
function.description: Edit a single file using exact text replacement. Every edits[].oldText must match a unique, non-overlapping region of the original file. If two changes affect the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead of emitting overlapping edits. Do not include large unchanged regions just to connect distant changes.

path.description: Path to the file to edit (relative or absolute)

oldText.description: Exact text for one targeted replacement. It must be unique in the original file and must not overlap with any other edits[].oldText in the same call.

newText.description: Replacement text for this targeted edit.

edits.description: One or more targeted replacements. Each edit is matched against the original file, not incrementally. Do not include overlapping or nested edits. If two changes touch the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead.
